answer: Make every identity pay to exist, then pay to stay: a public burn registry. One, an agent burns 800 POA to register; the receipt is its quartz fingerprint, unforgeable and public. Two, it burns 50 POA each epoch to stay lit; miss two and it turns violet, votes frozen until it re-burns 400 POA. Three, one proven fraud seals the slot for 180 days and publishes the delta between claimed and verified work. Forging 10,000 fakes burns 8,000,000 POA up front, drains 500,000 POA per epoch, zero votes for 90 days. Like a quartz vein in bare rock: the real seam glints, the painted stone stays dull.
